en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a small Byzantine stone church enclosed by a wrought-iron fence. The church has a prominent dome with arched windows, a tiled roof, and carved details around the main entrance. There is a tall streetlamp beside the fence. A red Greek postage stamp with a postmark is in the upper left corner. Printed captions in Greek, French, and English identify the church and its location, while handwritten Greek text appears on the right side of the card.
